scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained for arbitrary characteristic; finite enumeration is corroboration only. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only linear rank-one weight-zero Rota-Baxter operators on full matrix algebras; no classification for higher operator rank.
Finite-field results count distinct labeled operators, not conjugacy classes.
The rank-one dimension-two classification is already covered up to equivalences in the cited 2018 literature.
Publication priority for the all-dimension enumeration remains provisional.
title: Rank-one Rota–Baxter operators on matrix algebras: a two-stratum classification and exact finite-field census
